chose: Two of the owner's rulings of 2026-11-21, as built. (1) A screen in an essay is the phone at three-quarter size with the caption below it. Every whole screen, a snip with no parts named or a clip frame, is drawn by the screen-zoom composition with no stops (wholePicture). It holds the phone in the room above the frame's foot, where the captions draw, on the series' ground, so a portrait phone stands about three quarters of the frame's height when the foot is a quarter. A clip frame is read as a screen of its PNG's own size, scale 1. (2) #3137, option (b): a row of the release APK's controls is its tab bar only when it sits at the foot of what the app draws (its lowest edge within ROW_PX of the app's lowest edge) or one of its tabs is selected. The width rule (BAR_SPAN) is gone. tabBar is pure, in lib/snips, and tested.
